parameter_notes.aucpext: percentage of AUC(0-inf) that is extrapolated, in percent
parameter_notes.lambda.z: 1/h; selected by PKNCA best adjusted R squared among the last 3 or more points, Tmax excluded
parameter_notes.mrt: extravascular: mrt.obs/mrt.pred = AUMC/AUC (no absorption-time correction); IV: mrt.iv.obs/mrt.iv.pred
parameter_notes.cl: dose / AUC(0-inf); this is CL/F for the oral case
parameter_notes.vz: dose / (lambda.z * AUC(0-inf)); this is Vz/F for the oral case

preprocessing: none: the profile is given to PKNCA as it is in the data file; no point is added
case_note: negative concentrations kept (PKNCA only warns); linear rule, because lin up/log down gives NaN areas on a negative value

documented_differences.note: PKNCA takes the trailing negative concentration as Tlast and Clast; Caladrius never does

derived_parameters.aumcpext.obs: 100 * (1 - aumclast / aumcinf.obs), computed by the script: PKNCA has no such parameter
derived_parameters.aumcpext.pred: 100 * (1 - aumclast / aumcinf.pred), computed by the script: PKNCA has no such parameter
